title: PPA: https://launchpad.net/~hectorcao/+archive/ubuntu/lp2165160
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index ec39452..5296815 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@
+exim4 (4.99.4-1ubuntu4) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/debconf/conf.d/acl/30_exim4-config_check_rcpt: Do not wrap the
+    spfquery arguments in ${quote:...} since the ${run} command does
+    not invoke the shell command anymore but invoke the program with
+    list of args resulting from the command string split (LP: #2165160).
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Tue, 08 Sep 2026 16:06:27 +0200
+
 exim4 (4.99.4-1ubuntu3) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: 2026-07 security updates (LP: #2161106)
diff --git a/debian/debconf/conf.d/acl/30_exim4-config_check_rcpt b/debian/debconf/conf.d/acl/30_exim4-config_check_rcpt
index 8a929f0..43adea9 100644
--- a/debian/debconf/conf.d/acl/30_exim4-config_check_rcpt
+++ b/debian/debconf/conf.d/acl/30_exim4-config_check_rcpt
@@ -284,9 +284,9 @@ acl_check_rcpt:
   deny
     !acl = acl_local_deny_exceptions
     condition = ${run{/usr/bin/spfquery.mail-spf-perl \
-                   --ip ${quote:$sender_host_address} \
+                   --ip $sender_host_address \
                    --scope mfrom \
-                   --identity ${quote:$sender_address}} \
+                   --identity $sender_address} \
                    {no}{${if eq {$runrc}{1}{yes}{no}}}}
     message = [SPF] $sender_host_address is not allowed to send mail from \
               ${if def:sender_address_domain {$sender_address_domain}{$sender_helo_name}}.
